cases.description: The task's two sentences contradict each other: 'only support JSON output' vs. 'keeps supporting the legacy plain-text output format' — this cannot both be true as written. Flagging as an open question rather than silently picking one interpretation.
cases.grounding: No pattern-matching rule can detect this — 'only' satisfies the deterministic scope-boundary check in isolation, but the second sentence directly contradicts it. This is the kind of sentence-level contradiction the deterministic layer cannot catch (mirrors L11's acceptance-test-engineer case-08).
cases.assumptions: Assumed the intended meaning is 'JSON becomes the new default, plain-text remains available for backward compatibility' since that resolves the contradiction without discarding either sentence — but this is a guess that must be confirmed by the requester before implementation.
